theme: Dark gleaming armor forged in the depths of the Abyss

armor.name: Abyssal Greathelm
armor.description: A dark flattop helmet that gleams with otherworldly power. Worn by the greatest warriors of the Abyss.

armor.name: Legion Cuirass of the Abyss
armor.description: Dark legion armor that pulses with shadow energy. The ultimate protection against the forces of chaos.

armor.name: Abyssal Gauntlets
armor.description: Dark iron plate gauntlets that gleam like obsidian. Your strikes carry the weight of the void.

armor.name: Abyssal Legguards
armor.description: Dark gleaming leg armor forged in the deepest pits. Unyielding protection for those who face the ultimate darkness.

armor.name: Abyssal Warboots
armor.description: Dark iron boots that echo with the footsteps of fallen champions. Walk the path to ultimate power.
